understanding: Monitor-level X/Z protocol check: error on X/Z sampled on WISHBONE serial modem and interrupt signals plus reset-known non-X/Z check after wb_rst_i deassertion; depends on reset bring-up and transaction monitors; uses RTL port names for code and spec references for behavior.
preconditions: Clock on wb_clk_i stable at symbolic P_fixed before any reset or sampling
Reset on wb_rst_i asserted to symbolic RST_ACTIVE then deasserted before configuration as first test step
Monitors for wishbone_slave_interface uart_serial_data modem_control_if and interrupt_output active through reset until test end

All DUT inputs owned to avoid testbench Z: wishbone_slave_interface drives wb_adr_i wb_dat_i wb_sel_i wb_we_i wb_stb_i wb_cyc_i and uart_serial_data drives srx_pad_i and modem_control_if drives cts_pad_i dsr_pad_i ri_pad_i dcd_pad_i; clock and reset driven by testbench
stimulus_steps: START clock on wb_clk_i with period P_fixed; HOLD fixed for test
ASSERT reset on wb_rst_i to RST_ACTIVE
WAIT symbolic reset duration scaled to P_fixed
DEASSERT reset on wb_rst_i to inactive level
WAIT symbolic settle cycles for DUT outputs to reach known values

DRIVE idle known values on wb_adr_i wb_dat_i wb_sel_i wb_we_i wb_stb_i wb_cyc_i via wishbone_slave_interface and on srx_pad_i via uart_serial_data and on cts_pad_i dsr_pad_i ri_pad_i dcd_pad_i via modem_control_if; HOLD through checks
check_steps: SAMPLE on each observed clock edge wb_adr_i wb_sel_i wb_dat_i wb_dat_o wb_we_i wb_stb_i wb_cyc_i wb_ack_o wb_clk_i wb_rst_i int_o stx_pad_o srx_pad_i rts_pad_o dtr_pad_o cts_pad_i dsr_pad_i ri_pad_i dcd_pad_i [f_wb_addr_1 f_wb_sel_1 f_wb_data_1 f_wb_hs_1 f_int_o_1]; IF any sampled value is X or Z THEN REPORT uvm_error
WAIT for reset deassertion on wb_rst_i [f_wb_rst_1]; SAMPLE wb_dat_o wb_ack_o int_o stx_pad_o rts_pad_o dtr_pad_o; IF any is X or Z THEN REPORT error ELSE RECORD known-check pass

COMPARE reset-known state [f_init_fifo_1 f_init_shift_1 f_init_div_1 f_init_lcr_1 f_init_ier_1 f_mcr_rst_1]: IF Divisor Latch != 0 THEN REPORT error; IF LCR != 8-bits no-parity 1-stop THEN REPORT error; IF any IER interrupt enabled THEN REPORT error; IF FIFOs or shift registers not cleared THEN REPORT error
coverage_steps: SAMPLE cover_xz_activation on each monitor sample of control and data
SAMPLE cover_xz_error on each X-or-Z error report
SAMPLE cover_known_after_reset when DUT outputs sampled known non-X/Z after reset deassertion
TAP monitor analysis ports with dedicated subscribers; drivers never supply coverage
completion: END when reset assertion plus deassertion plus settle window sampled and at least one known-value COMPARE observed
BOUND by TEST_TIMEOUT_CYCLES operational limit; timeout is testbench limit not DUT timing

facts.statement: CLK is block clock input driven by testbench.
WB_ADDR_I is input used for register selection.
facts.quote: WB_ADDR_I 5 or 3 Input Used for register selection

facts.statement: WB_DAT_I is data input and WB_DAT_O is data output.
facts.quote:
WB_DAT_I 32 or 8 Input Data input
WB_DAT_O 32 or 8 Output Data output

facts.statement: WB_WE_I WB_STB_I WB_CYC_I are control inputs and WB_ACK_O is acknowledge output.
facts.quote:
WB_WE_I 1 Input Write or read cycle selection
WB_STB_I 1 Input Specifies transfer cycle
WB_CYC_I 1 Input A bus cycle is in progress
WB_ACK_O 1 Output Acknowledge of a transfer

facts.statement: Upon reset receiver and transmitter FIFOs are cleared.
facts.quote: The receiver and transmitter FIFOs are cleared.

facts.statement: Upon reset receiver and transmitter shift registers are cleared.
facts.quote: The receiver and transmitter shift registers are cleared

facts.statement: Upon reset Divisor Latch register is set to 0.
facts.quote: The Divisor Latch register is set to 0.

facts.statement: Upon reset Line Control Register is 8 bits data no parity 1 stop bit.
facts.quote:
The Line Control Register is set to communication of 8 bits of data, no parity, 1
stop bit.

facts.statement: Upon reset all interrupts are disabled in Interrupt Enable Register.
facts.quote: All interrupts are disabled in the Interrupt Enable Register.

questions: What signals are in documented known-value set after reset for X/Z checking beyond FIFOs and shift registers cleared, Divisor 0, LCR 8N1, IER disabled — specifically expected non-X/Z levels for wb_dat_o wb_ack_o int_o stx_pad_o rts_pad_o dtr_pad_o?
What is documented active polarity and inactive level of WB_RST_I on wb_rst_i? Source states only Asynchronous Reset.
What is documented minimum assert duration in clock cycles for WB_RST_I and required deassert-to-configuration delay and post-deassert settle for known check?
What is documented nominal clock period P_fixed and operating range for wb_clk_i?
What is documented CLK sampling edge for X/Z monitors and reset sampling relative to CLK?
Does X/Z error apply during reset assertion or only after deassertion, and must testbench drive all inputs to avoid Z during reset?
What are documented pad levels after MCR Reset Value 0 given inverted DTR and RTS mapping?
